source_name: NASA LP DAAC / Google Earth Engine
license: NASA Earthdata / LP DAAC terms; verify before redistribution
crs: MODIS sinusoidal grid; aggregate to municipal polygons before modeling
coverage_end_policy: catalog rolling; pin retrieval date and image collection IDs in snapshot manifest

SummaryQA.use: mask low-quality pixels; accepted values must be declared

DetailedQA.use: audit VI quality, usefulness, aerosol, cloud and BRDF flags

aggregation_required: zonal statistics by IBGE municipal polygon; do not use city names as keys
monthly_aggregation: area-weighted median/p10/p90/valid_pixel_fraction from 16-day composites available before forecast cutoff
available_at_rule: each composite must carry system time_start plus provider/catalog publish lag; monthly features may only use composites with available_at <= forecast_cutoff
quality_rules: reject snapshot without SummaryQA or DetailedQA
record image IDs and checksums/manifests for reproducibility
fail closed when geocodigo mapping or municipal geometry is missing
do not promote CSV exports without QA, product version and available_at
current_local_csv_reason: NDVI_Ceara_Municipios_Mensal_FINAL.csv has broad target coverage but lacks QA bands, product version, zonal geometry metadata, published_at and available_at.
